name: crazy-goat/ladybug-ext
description: Native PHP extension for LadybugDB (embedded graph database) — the ext-ladybug backend of crazy-goat/ladybug-php

suggest.crazy-goat/ladybug-php: The PHP API this extension backs; the extension alone exposes only ladybug_* functions

configure-options.name: with-liblbug
configure-options.description: Directory holding lbug.h and the liblbug library. Required unless liblbug is installed somewhere standard: the build searches /usr/local, /usr and /opt/homebrew.

configure-options.name: enable-ladybug-static
configure-options.description: Link liblbug.a into the extension instead of depending on the shared library. Needs a liblbug-static release. Strongly recommended on Linux: a dynamically linked liblbug 0.19.x crashes the process on INSTALL when any extension carrying libstdc++ is loaded.
